statements.1:
Goal

Maximize the score on a custom 32x32 Reversi board by determining the sequence of moves for both players.

  Rules

The game is played on a 32x32 grid, containing 1024 cells.

Cell Indexing

Cells are numbered sequentially from 0 to 1023 in row-major order:

  • The top-left cell (row 0, column 0) has the index 0.
  • The index increases by 1 for each cell from left to right along each row, starting from the top row and continuing to the next row down.
  • The bottom-right cell (row 31, column 31) has the index 1023.

Gameplay

  • You control both players black and white.
  • Black always moves first.
  • Turns alternate between black and white.
  • A move consists of placing a piece on an empty cell.
  • A placed piece must sandwich one or more opponent pieces in at least one of the 8 directions between the newly placed piece and another piece of the current player's color.
  • All sandwiched opponent pieces are flipped to the current player's color.
  • If a player has no valid moves, their turn is automatically skipped.
  • The game ends when neither player can make a valid move.

Scoring

  • Each move that flips N opponent's pieces earns N^4 - 5 points.
  • After all moves have been applied, the total score is multiplied by the smaller of the black and white piece counts.

  Protocol

Input

32 lines: A string of length 32 per line, representing the initial board state (B for black, W for white, . for empty).

Output
A space-separated sequence of cell indices, representing the moves to be played in chronological order.
Constraints
  • It is guaranteed that black always has a valid initial move.
  • The execution time limit is 12000 ms.
